sourceCautions: The engineering raw Fourier transform has a minus exponent; RCA19.2 uses the upper half-plane and a plus exponent. The own outer-function proof explicitly reflects the half-plane.
MIT2010 CT minimum-phase discussion explicitly limits a causal stable inverse equivalence to equal finite pole/zero counts. Strictly proper inverse differentiation is not BIBO stable.

MIT2010 printed51 Eq3.15 appears to retain the positive-center phase in the negative-frequency expansion. The chapter derives its own Hermitian phase and exact complex Gaussian construction; it does not transfer that sign.
The real-line gain–phase sign and normalization are derived for the declared rational family, not copied from the circle convention in RCA17.23.
